facets.bk: Juju Zombie Fighter from the Tome of Horrors Complete

body:
This creature looks like a desiccated humanoid with grayish, leathery flesh. It is dressed in filthy rags, and its eyes are small pinpoints of crimson light. An odor of death hangs in the air around the creature.

Juju Zombie Fighter
CR 3

XP 800
Male human juju zombie fighter 3
NE Medium undead (augmented humanoid)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 13, flat-footed 19 (+6 armor, +3 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 28 (3d10+18 plus 6)
Fort +5; Ref +4; Will +1
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +4; DR 5/magic and slashing; Immune cold, electricity, magic missile, undead traits; Resist fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee longsword +9 (1d8+5/19–20) or slam +8 (1d6+7)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 16, Con —, Int 4, Wis 10, Cha 14
Base Atk +3; CMB +8 (+10 sunder); CMD 21 (23 vs. sunder)
Feats Alertness, CleaveB, Improved InitiativeB, Improved SunderB, Power AttackB, ToughnessB, Weapon Focus (longsword)
Skills Acrobatics +0, Climb +13, Perception +2, Ride +0, Sense Motive +2; Racial Modifiers +8 Climb
Languages Common
SQ armor training 1
Gear chainmail, longsword

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, band (3–7), or company (10–20)
Treasure standard
